experiments.name: Hook test: testimonial vs founder
experiments.question: Which opening hook earns more purchases per rupiah?
experiments.hypothesis: Customer testimonial hooks will lower CPA by at least 15% vs founder talking head because social proof appears in the first 3 seconds.
experiments.notes: Spend split was uneven in week 1 (Advantage+ delivery).

experiments.name: Bundle price anchor
experiments.question: Does showing the 2-box bundle price raise AOV?
experiments.hypothesis: Anchoring with the bundle price will raise AOV by 10% without lowering CVR.

experiments.name: Broad vs LAL 1%
experiments.question: Is the lookalike still outperforming broad?
experiments.hypothesis: Broad targeting will match LAL 1% ROAS at a lower CPM.
experiments.conclusion: Broad matched ROAS (2.31 vs 2.28) with lower CPM. Evidence moderate: 41 vs 38 purchases.
experiments.next_action: Shift 30% of LAL budget to broad and re-check in 14 days.

experiments.name: Static vs video on catalog
experiments.question: Does video lift catalog conversion?
experiments.hypothesis: Short video will raise ATC rate by 20%.

experiments.name: Checkout trust badges
experiments.question: Do trust badges reduce checkout drop-off?
experiments.hypothesis: Adding COD + returns badges on landing page will raise IC→Purchase rate by 15%.
experiments.notes: LP change made outside Meta; track via pixel.

decisions.hypothesis: ROAS stays above 2.5 after a 33% budget increase.

decisions.notes: CTR kept falling. Fatigue likely creative, not audience.
